messages:
marie (AE): Kicking off FinWave trial — scope is doc search + extractive summarization + RAG. Need to lock success criteria, golden prompts, scoring, and any pricing/security blockers before kickoff. Can we align today?

josh (SE): Quick Qs: will the data stay in their VPC? expected qps? latency SLOs? these affect model choice and infra.

marie (AE): Data must remain in their VPC for PII docs. QPS low (burst ~20r/s), target p95 latency < 400ms for single-turn extracts. Win condition: accuracy on goldens >= 85% and no correctness regressions week-over-week. Thoughts?

sam (SalesEng): Timeline proposal: 2-week seed eval (golden set + prompt tuning) -> 4-week pilot with live traffic. For pricing: offer POC credit covering baseline usage, then convert to reserved/dedicated if they ramp. Need to confirm security asks.

emily (PM): Draft golden prompts attached below (seed). We should include anchor prompts, edge-cases, and adversarial noisy inputs. Example entries: 
```
{"id":"g-001","prompt":"Extract vendor, invoice_date, total_amount from: [INVOICE_TEXT]","expected":"vendor: Acme Corp; invoice_date: 2025-02-11; total_amount: $12,345.67"}
{"id":"g-002","prompt":"Short summary (2 sentences) of the following contract clause: [CLAUSE_TEXT]","expected":"Summarize obligations, parties, and termination triggers"}
```
Use these to drive both exact entity checks and semantic scoring.

josh (SE): For the eval harness we should combine: exact-entity match (regex/slot match), ROUGE-L for summary quality, and a sentence-embedding cosine >= 0.82 for semantic equivalence. Scoring rubric suggestion: exact entity = 60% weight, semantic summary = 30%, safety/format checks = 10%. Regression gate: fail if end-to-end rubric drops more than 4% vs baseline.

sec (Security): FinWave requires SOC2 and customer-managed keys. Private deployment (VPC peering) is mandatory for PII. I'll attach the short checklist: KMS integration, audit log retention 90d, and egress locked down. Link to onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/vpc-playbook (internal).

ben (Finance): On pricing: propose POC credit of $5k covering ~250k tokens. If they exceed, bill at overage rate (hosted rate) or upgrade to Dedicated with a short-term commit. Note: KV-cache/cold-start reductions can cut token spend ~30% for their workload.

marie (AE): @sam can we guarantee prefix/KV caching for the pilot to hit that 30% savings? also confirm model families that meet p95 < 400ms on their region.

sam (SalesEng): Yes — we can enable prefix/KV caching and apply a cache-config for doc search. Recommended model: rdlw-7b-quant variant for cost/latency balance in hosted; Dedicated options if they need higher concurrency.

josh (SE): Operational notes for harness: run 3 seeds per prompt, sample 200 golden items initially, store golden answers in hashed form for verification, and pipeline should produce per-prompt metrics + aggregate. Hook regression alerts to Slack and Console.

emily (PM): Acceptance criteria (short): 1) Golden rubric >= 85% 2) Regression gate <= 4% drop 3) p95 latency < 400ms 4) Security checklist signed + VPC peering 5) Pilot cost within POC credit or signed commit. Can everyone confirm? :rocket:

sec (Security): Confirmed on security checklist pending FinWave legal signature.

ben (Finance): Confirmed on pricing approach. Will provision credit and monitor usage thresholds.

sam (SalesEng): Confirmed for caching and model recommendations.

josh (SE): I'll spin up the eval harness tomorrow and post the seedset + scoring config in this thread. Expect initial results in 48h.

marie (AE): Thanks all — meeting booked for tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize prompts and timelines. Agenda: golden set review, scoring weights, security gating, and billing cadence. :thumbsup:
